LanguageData.AGB.RoleDesc_None: Handled by the species' breeding program rules.
LanguageData.AGB.RoleDesc_Breeder: Allowed to breed even when the species is restricted to breeders. Never auto-slaughtered.
LanguageData.AGB.RoleDesc_Keep: Never auto-slaughtered. Breeds according to the species' mating rules.
LanguageData.AGB.RoleDesc_Cull: Never breeds. First in line for auto-slaughter.
LanguageData.AGB.CommandRoleDesc:
Set this animal's herd role (applies to all selected animals).

Breeder: may breed and is never auto-slaughtered.
Keep: never auto-slaughtered.
Cull: never breeds, slaughtered first.
LanguageData.AGB.NoAnimals: You have no animals with genetics on this map.
LanguageData.AGB.SectionGoalTip: How much each gene counts toward the breeding score. Set a gene to 0 to ignore it.
LanguageData.AGB.MatingTip_Open: Any male may breed (vanilla behavior). Cull-tagged animals still never breed.
LanguageData.AGB.MatingTip_BreedersOnly: Only males with the Breeder role may breed.
LanguageData.AGB.MatingTip_BestMales: The top males by breeding score may breed, plus any male with the Breeder role. Rankings update automatically.
LanguageData.AGB.BestMalesCount: Number of best males allowed to breed: {0}
LanguageData.AGB.FemalesNeedBreeder: Females also need the Breeder role
LanguageData.AGB.FemalesNeedBreederTip: If checked, only females with the Breeder role can be bred.
LanguageData.AGB.GeneAwareSlaughterTip: Vanilla auto-slaughter still decides how many animals go. With this on, the ones with the lowest breeding score go first instead of the oldest. Breeder and Keep animals are never auto-slaughtered either way.
LanguageData.AGB.ProtectTop: Protect the best {0} of each sex
LanguageData.AGB.ProtectTopTip: The top animals of each sex by breeding score are never auto-slaughtered.
LanguageData.AGB.SlaughterCulledTip: Cull-tagged animals are slaughtered even if you are under the auto-slaughter limits.
LanguageData.AGB.SlaughterBelowTip: Adults with a breeding score below the threshold are slaughtered even if you are under the auto-slaughter limits. Protected animals are exempt.
LanguageData.AGB.ClickToSelect: Click to jump to and select this animal.
LanguageData.AGB.SettingInbreedingTip: When on, children of related parents get worse genes, in proportion to how related the parents are. Off by default.
LanguageData.AGB.SettingPenalty: Full-sibling children lose {0}% on every gene
LanguageData.AGB.SettingPenaltyTip: Gene loss scales with the inbreeding coefficient: half siblings lose half as much, cousins about a quarter.
LanguageData.AGB.KinClose: full siblings or parent and child
LanguageData.AGB.NoPairs: You need at least one fertile male and one fertile female (not Cull) of this species.
LanguageData.AGB.PredScore: Child breeding score: {0} on average (90% of children between {1} and {2})
LanguageData.AGB.PredBeatsParents: Chance a child beats both parents: {0}
LanguageData.AGB.PredBeatsHerd: Chance a child beats your best animal ({1}): {0}
LanguageData.AGB.PredPenaltyOff: (Inbreeding depression is off in mod settings.)
LanguageData.AGB.PredBlocked: Current mating rules prevent this pair from breeding.
LanguageData.AGB.SuggestedPairs: Best pairs by expected child score
LanguageData.AGB.SamplePreserved: Preserved (frozen or in a powered cryobank)
LanguageData.AGB.SampleViable: Viable for {0} more days unless frozen
LanguageData.AGB.SampleExpired: {0} is no longer viable and was discarded.
LanguageData.AGB.SampleCollected: A germline sample was collected from {0}.
LanguageData.AGB.InseminationFailed: Insemination of {0} failed. The sample was used up.
LanguageData.AGB.CommandCollectDesc:
Have a handler collect a germline sample from this male. The sample keeps his exact genes and can be used to inseminate females later, even after he is gone.
Samples stay viable for 3 days unless frozen or kept in a powered cryobank.
LanguageData.AGB.CommandInseminateDesc: Choose a germline sample. A handler will bring it and inseminate this female (60% chance, +3% per Animals skill level, up to 95%). Egg-layers will lay fertilized eggs fathered by the sample.
LanguageData.AGB.CommandInseminatePending: Waiting for a handler to inseminate with {0}. Click to cancel.
LanguageData.AGB.CannotReceive: Not fertile right now (pregnant, already fertilized, sterile or too young).
LanguageData.AGB.NoSamples: There are no germline samples for {0} on this map.
LanguageData.AGB.CommandSerumDesc:
Choose a breeding serum. A handler will give it to this female; it changes how her next offspring inherit genes.

Dominance: one chosen gene always comes from the better parent.
Stabilizing: children mutate much less.
Mutagenic: children mutate much more.
LanguageData.AGB.CommandSerumPending: Waiting for a handler to give {0}. Click to cancel.
LanguageData.AGB.NoSerums: There are no breeding serums on this map.
LanguageData.AGB.CommandSpliceDesc: Move one gene from a donor sample into a target sample stored in this cryobank. The target's gene moves {0}% of the way to the donor's value; the donor sample is used up. A doctor does the work; the cryobank must be powered.
LanguageData.AGB.CommandSplicePending: Waiting for a doctor to splice {2} from {1} into {0}. Click to cancel.
LanguageData.AGB.SpliceNeedsTwo: Store at least two samples of the same species in this cryobank.
LanguageData.AGB.SpliceExplain: Pick the sample to improve, the sample to take a gene from, then the gene. The gene moves {0}% of the way to the donor's value.
LanguageData.AGB.SplicePickFirst: Pick a target and a donor of the same species first.
LanguageData.AGB.GenomeProfile: Taken from {0} (breeding score {1}). Hybrids made with it inherit these genes:
LanguageData.AGB.LineageInspect: Carries genome genetics: the hybrid will inherit them.
